thread.title: 3 Reasons Why Stocks Are Crashing Again - TheStreet

author: Brian Sozzi
title: 3 Reasons Why Stocks Are Crashing Again - TheStreet
text:
Let the bloodbath in the markets continue. 
After an attempt at a reversal Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average crashed in the early afternoon. By 2:00 p.m. EST, the Dow was down about 425 points. Some of the world's biggest stocks are leading the markets lower, which is certainly not a good sign. 
Top Dow laggards included 3M ( MMM ) , Chevron ( CVX ) , Exxon Mobil ( XOM ) and Action Alerts Plus holding General Electric ( GE ) . Oddly enough, Action Alerts Plus holding Apple ( AAPL ) traded higher as it sought to stay above the key 200-day moving average of $160.
